b:
^Anjali Rao: You reported that approval fast, so we isolated the account before it could send messages, reset passwords or reach the shared drive.

^Anjali Rao: A trusted internal account is worth more to them than any outside one. Speed is what closes the gap.

^Anjali Rao: That spoofed sign-in approval, during the migration when a re-sign-in was expected, was the one to report at once.

^Anjali Rao: It stood, so the shared drive went down and work stopped while we rebuilt it from backup.
^Anjali Rao: You're covering Ayaan's inbox at the training kiosk. He clicked a convincing email, so someone else is in his account. Some signs are real, some ordinary. Report anything odd.
